text_en: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all those who stood by him, and he cried out, “Send everyone away from me. ” So no one stayed with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
text_cn: 若瑟在众侍从前不能再抑制自己，就喊说：“叫众人离开我出去！”这样，若瑟使兄弟认出自己来时，没有别人在场。

text_en: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard it, and the household of Pharaoh heard it.
text_cn: 他便放声大哭，埃及人都听到了，法郎朝廷也听到了。

text_en: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph. Is my father still alive? ” But his brothers could not answer him, so dismayed were they at his presence.
text_cn: 若瑟对兄弟们说：“我就是若瑟，我父亲还在吗？”他的兄弟们不能回答，因为在他面前都吓呆了。

text_en: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Come closer to me. ” And they came closer. He said, “I am your brother, Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.
text_cn: 若瑟又对兄弟们说：“请你们近前来。”他们就上前去。若瑟说：“我就是你们卖到埃及的弟弟若瑟。

text_en: And now do not be distressed, or angry with yourselves, because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life.
text_cn: 现在你们不要因为将我卖到这里便自忧自责；这原是天主派遣我在你们以先来，为保全你们的性命。

text_en: For the famine has been in the land these two years; and there are five more years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.
text_cn: 地方上的饥荒才过了第二年，还有五年，不能耕种，不能收割。

text_en: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on earth, and to keep alive for you many survivors.
text_cn: 天主派遣我在你们以先来，是为给你们在地上留下后裔，给你们保全多人的性命。

text_en: So it was not you who sent me here, but God; he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 所以叫我到这里来的并不是你们，而是天主；是他立我作法郎之父，作他全家的主人，作全埃及地的总理。

text_en: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, ‘Thus says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, do not delay.
text_cn: 你们急速上到我父亲那里，对他说：你的儿子若瑟这样说：天主立我作了全埃及的主人，请你下到我这里来，不要迟延。

text_en: You shall settle in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me, you and your children and your children’s children, as well as your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
text_cn: 你和你的儿孙，以及你的羊群牲畜，并你一切所有，都可住在哥笙地，离我不远，

text_en: I will provide for you there—since there are five more years of famine to come—so that you and your household, and all that you have, will not come to poverty. ’
text_cn: 我好在那里奉养你，免得你和你的眷属，并你一切所有陷于贫乏，因为尚有五年饥荒。

text_en: And now your eyes and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see that it is my own mouth that speaks to you.
text_cn: 看你们和我的弟弟本雅明都亲眼见到，是我亲口在对你们说话。

text_en: You must tell my father how greatly I am honored in Egypt, and all that you have seen. Hurry and bring my father down here. ”
text_cn: 你们要将我在埃及的一切光荣，和你们亲见的一切，都告诉我父亲，尽速带我父亲下到这里来。”

text_en: Then he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, while Benjamin wept upon his neck.
text_cn: 说毕，便扑在他弟弟本雅明的颈上哭起来了，本雅明也伏在他颈上哭泣。

text_en: And he kissed all his brothers and wept upon them; and after that his brothers talked with him.
text_cn: 然后与众兄弟亲吻，抱着他们痛哭。这以后，他的兄弟们才敢与他交谈。

text_en: When the report was heard in Pharaoh’s house, “Joseph’s brothers have come, ” Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
text_cn: 法郎朝廷听说若瑟兄弟来了的消息，法郎和他的臣仆都很高兴。

text_en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: load your animals and go back to the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 法郎便对若瑟说：“你对你的兄弟们说：你们应这样做：备好牲口，立即往客纳罕地去，

text_en: Take your father and your households and come to me, so that I may give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you may enjoy the fat of the land. ’
text_cn: 接你们的父亲和家眷到我这里来，我愿赐给你们埃及地最好的出产，使你们享受本地的肥物。

text_en: You are further charged to say, ‘Do this: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
text_cn: 你再吩咐他们说：你们应这样做：从埃及带些车辆去接你们的子女和妻子，并把你们的父亲接来；

text_en: Give no thought to your possessions, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours. ’”
text_cn: 不要顾惜你们的物品，因为全埃及地最好的出品都归你们享用。”

text_en: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons according to the instruction of Pharaoh, and he gave them provisions for the journey.
text_cn: 以色列的儿子们就这样做了。若瑟依照法郎的吩咐，给了他们一些车辆和路上用的食粮；

text_en: To each one of them he gave a set of garments; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five sets of garments.
text_cn: 又给了每人一套新衣，至于本雅明，却给了他三百银钱和五套新衣；

text_en: To his father he sent the following: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and provision for his father on the journey.
text_cn: 同样，给他父亲送去十匹公驴，满载埃及最好的出品，十匹母驴，满载粮食面饼，和为父亲路上用的食品。

text_en: Then he sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving he said to them, “Do not quarrel along the way. ”
text_cn: 随后打发他的兄弟们走了；当他们离别时，对他们说：“路上不要争吵！”

text_en: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 若瑟的兄弟们由埃及上到客纳罕，他们父亲雅各伯那里，

text_en: And they told him, “Joseph is still alive! He is even ruler over all the land of Egypt. ” He was stunned; he could not believe them.
text_cn: 告诉他说：“若瑟还活着，而且做了全埃及国的总理。”雅各伯听了心中淡然，并不相信。

text_en: But when they told him all the words of Joseph that he had said to them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
text_cn: 及至他们将若瑟对他们所说的话，全讲给他听，他又看了若瑟打发来接他的车辆，他们的父亲雅各伯的心神才苏醒过来。

text_en: Israel said, “Enough! My son Joseph is still alive. I must go and see him before I die. ”
text_cn: 以色列于是说：“只要我儿若瑟还在，我就心满意足了；在我未死以前，我该去见他一面。”
